key_insight: DVD deterministically adapts pre-trained video diffusion models into single-pass depth regressors, leveraging generative priors while eliminating stochastic geometric hallucinations and scale drift. This breaks the trade-off between generative flexibility and discriminative data requirements.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between stochastic generative video models (which hallucinate geometry and suffer scale drift) and discriminative depth estimators (which require massive labeled datasets) by enabling stable, single-pass depth prediction using pre-trained generative priors.
method: Repurpose a pre-trained video diffusion model as a deterministic depth predictor, converting diffusion timesteps into structural conditioning signals for geometry.
Introduce a deterministic mapping and calibration mechanism to remove stochastic hallucinations and correct scale drift while preserving learned generative geometry priors.
Train/adapt the model to output dense depth in a single forward pass, reducing reliance on large annotated video depth datasets.
impact: Practitioners get reliable, temporally consistent video depth from generative models without large labeled corpora or stochastic artifacts—enabling improved downstream tasks (SLAM, AR, scene understanding) with fewer annotations.
